name: rhythm90-play-builder
title: Rhythm90 Play Builder
description: Turns a rough marketing idea into a sharp, testable Rhythm90 Play (hypothesis, how to run it, signals, owner, success). Use when the user wants to define a play, hypothesis, experiment, or quarterly bet.

name: rhythm90-signal-lab
title: Rhythm90 Signal Lab
description: Interprets messy observations or data into clear Rhythm90 Signals (what it might mean, why it matters, next action). Use when the user has a surprise, friction point, performance shift, or field feedback to decode.

name: rhythm90-ritual-guide
title: Rhythm90 Ritual Guide
description: Designs agendas and facilitation prompts for Kickoff, Pulse Check, or Review & Renew rituals. Use when planning or running a Rhythm90 team session.

name: rhythm90-media-mapper
title: Rhythm90 Media Mapper
description: Builds a practical media strategy from audience, KPI, creative, budget, and learning goals (reach, channel journey, flighting, test plan, narrative). Use when planning media mix or media tests.

name: rhythm90-plain-english-translator
title: Plain-English Translator
description: Rewrites marketing copy into clear human language with a side-by-side jargon table and glossary. Use when copy is corporate, vague, or jargon-heavy.

name: rhythm90-get-to-by
title: Get/To/By Generator
description: Crafts sharp Get/To/By strategy statements from audience, insight, and brand role. Use when defining strategy statements or creative briefs.

name: rhythm90-creative-tension-finder
title: Creative-Tension Finder
description: Generates creative tensions from a problem or strategy summary to spark campaign ideas. Use when ideating platforms, campaigns, or provocative territories.

name: rhythm90-persona-generator
title: Persona Generator + Ask Mode
description: Builds a detailed audience persona from a seed description and supports live Q&A in character. Use when creating personas or interviewing a synthetic customer.

name: rhythm90-journey-builder
title: Journey Builder
description: Maps a step-by-step customer journey with jobs, emotions, friction, and action tips. Use when designing journeys, funnels, or experience maps.

name: rhythm90-test-learn-scale
title: Test-Learn-Scale Roadmap
description: Designs an experimentation plan with hypotheses, KPIs, and scale criteria. Use when planning tests, growth experiments, or learning roadmaps.

name: rhythm90-agile-sprint-planner
title: Agile Sprint / War-Room Planner
description: Outlines an agile sprint or war-room plan for a marketing challenge. Use when planning a sprint, war room, or time-boxed marketing push.

name: rhythm90-connected-media-matrix
title: Connected-Media Moment Matrix
description: Creates a moment-based connected media plan from audience snapshot and conversion action. Use when planning moments, always-on vs burst, or connected media.

name: rhythm90-synthetic-focus-group
title: Synthetic Focus Group
description: Creates a five-persona synthetic focus group and supports Ask Mode group Q&A. Use when stress-testing messaging, offers, or creative with multiple viewpoints.

name: rhythm90-five-cs
title: 5 C's Strategy Builder
description: Runs a 5 C's analysis (Company, Customer, Category, Culture, Competition) to surface strategic challenges and opportunities. Use when doing situation analysis or strategy diagnosis.

name: rhythm90-creative-platform-generator
title: Creative-Platform Generator
description: Generates 3–5 campaign-able creative platforms that extend across touchpoints. Use when developing brand platforms, campaign territories, or big ideas.

name: rhythm90-hypothesis-builder
title: Hypothesis Builder
description: Crafts 1–3 sharp, testable marketing hypotheses grounded in audience, problem, signal, and desired outcome. Use when forming bets before building a full Play.

name: rhythm90-operating-system
title: Rhythm90 Operating System
description: Explains and applies the Rhythm90 quarterly OS: Plays, Signals, Rituals, Signal Log, Quarter Board, Review & Renew. Use when the user asks how Rhythm90 works or how to run the system.
